podcast.title: Late 1980s Success
podcast.body: Alannah Myles was among the new acts signed throughout the late 1980s who achieved hits and solid-selling albums. This success was incentivized by the serious prospect of radio airplay, coverage by MuchMusic, and funding assistance, reflecting a growing investment in Canadian talent by the recorded music industry. "Throughout the late 1980s, new acts were signed and had hits in solid-selling albums, Blue Rodeo, The Box, Pursuit of Happiness, Northern Pikes, National Velvet, Alana Miles, 5440, Cowboy Junkeys."

xref.title: Early Bandmate with Ian Thornley
xref.body: Kurt Schaffer was a guitarist in an early pop band with a 13-year-old Ian Thornley. Schaffer was 21 at the time and was the next youngest member of the band. He later gained recognition for playing with Alannah Myles, including on her hit "Black Velvet." "I was in a band with Kurt Schafter. He was the next young guy."
